Under 12¢ is good territory — at that rate a home miner actually stacks meaningfully instead of just burning power.

Two picks: the Magic Miner 40T at $799 (40 TH/s, ~650W) is the best value per terahash we sell. The Harlo B30 at $899 is 30 TH/s at ~400W, quieter and gentler on the wall.
